data.description: Investor's Deal | OP Price | Waterfront Living
data.long_description:
Provident estate is delighted to present this modern 1-bedroom apartment in the prestigious The Mural. Spanning 802.44 sq.ft., this mid-floor unit offers contemporary design, generous living space, and a comfortable layout, ideal for families or investors seeking a prime location in Dubai.

The apartment features one spacious bedrooms with two bathrooms,, a dedicated maid’s room, and an open-plan living and dining area that is perfect for entertaining or everyday family life. Large windows fill the home with natural light and provide serene views of the community and surroundings.

Property Details:
- 802.44 sq.ft.
- 1 Bedroom
- 2 Bathrooms

Key Features & Highlights:
- Bright and spacious living and dining area
- Modern kitchen with high-quality finishes and appliances
- Bedroom with private ensuite bathrooms
- Dedicated maid’s room with attached bathroom
- Central air conditioning throughout
- Built-in wardrobes and ample storage space
- Floor-to-ceiling windows for natural light and views

Building & Community Amenities:
- 24/7 security and CCTV surveillance
- Covered parking spaces for residents
- Well-maintained common areas and landscaped surroundings
- Swimming pool, gym, and recreational facilities
- Family-friendly community with parks and walking paths
- Convenient access to shopping, dining, and entertainment destinations

This apartment combines space, comfort, and modern living, making it a perfect home for families or a high-potential investment in Dubai.
